annotations.title: Pause or stop an ad campaign

description:
[writes · `write` scope, or `ads:manage`] Pauses a live ad campaign on its ad network so it stops spending (`action: "pause"` or `"stop"`; both leave it paused). Pausing never needs the owner's approval and is never limited by the agent ceiling. To approve and switch on a proposed campaign use ads_campaign_approve. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}/pause.)

action.description: stop = a pause you mean as final; the network shows paused either way.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand. A brand-bound key is always pinned to its brand; any other value is 403.

idempotencyKey.description: Retrying with the same key never runs the change twice.

name: ads_campaign_pause
